entries.title: Boom Beach
entries.definitive_edition: Current official PC launcher or mobile build with the same account state

emulation.notes: Use official PC launcher or mobile clients rather than Android emulation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official PC launcher at current live-service build

primary.version: Current official Boom Beach PC launcher
primary.why: Boom Beach is a live Supercell strategy game originally built for iOS/Android, and Supercell now offers an official Windows PC launcher route. PC is the cleanest capture route while mobile remains the original platform family.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official PC launcher for capture if available in-region, or the current iOS/Android build otherwise. Record Supercell ID, region, app/build version, base level, Task Force, event/season, monetization state, and whether PC or mobile client was used.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record event/season/build and Supercell ID state because the live game changes over time.
